name: pixel-pitch
description: Retro pixel-art 3v3 soccer with Solana token-gating and leaderboard airdrops

scripts.build: npm run build -w @pixel-pitch/shared && npm run build -w @pixel-pitch/server
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
